```yaml
name: Skill Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # daily

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '7.0.x'

      - name: Setup MSBuild
        uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v2
        with:
          vs-version: 'latest'

      - name: Install Skill Validator
        run: dotnet tool install --global dotnet-skill-validator

      - name: Run Skill Validator
        run: dotnet skill-validator --output metrics.json
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload metrics artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: metrics
          path: metrics.json

  aggregate:
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download metrics artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: metrics

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v1

      - name: Generate Token Data
        run: pwsh ./scripts/generate-token-data.ps1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Generate Benchmark Data
        run: pwsh ./scripts/generate-benchmark-data.ps1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload token data artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-data
          path: data/token-usage.json

      - name: Upload benchmark data artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-data
          path: benchmark.json

  publish:
    needs: aggregate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download benchmark data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-data

      - name: Publish Benchmark
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
        with:
          name: 'Skill Token Usage'
          tool: 'custom'
          output-file-path: 'benchmark.json'
          gh-pages-branch: 'gh-pages'
          gh-repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          benchmark-data-dir-path: 'data'
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          auto-push: true
          skip-fetch-gh-pages: false
          comment-always: false
          summary-always: false
          save-data-file: true
          comment-on-alert: false
          alert-threshold: 0
```
